title: Selective inhibition of p300 by a novel small molecule EPS496 promotes cell death in vemurafenib-resistant BRAF(V600E) mutated melanoma cells.
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子EPS496抑制p300乙酰转移酶以克服黑色素瘤耐药，虽用MD和MMPBSA模拟蛋白-配体结合，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Melanoma, a highly aggressive skin cancer is frequently driven by the BRAF(V600E) mutation. Vemurafenib initially offers clinical benefits but often encounters resistance due to secondary mutations and compensatory signaling pathways. Targeting p300, a histone acetyltransferase involved in transcriptional regulation and resistance mechanisms, presents a potential strategy to overcome this therapeutic challenge. METHODS: A virtual screening was conducted to identify small molecules targeting p300. Molecular dynamics simulations (MDS), Root Mean Square Deviation (RMSD), and Molecular Mechanics Poisson-Boltzmann Surface Area (MMPBSA) were employed for computational predictions. Normal (A2058, A375, and SK-MEL-28) and vemurafenib-resistant A2058(VR), A375 (VR), and SK-MEL-28 (VR) melanoma cells were used for cell-based assays. RESULTS: EPS496 was identified as a p300 inhibitor, demonstrating high binding stability with a low RMSD value during the MDS. MMPBSA analysis revealed highly favorable binding energy, indicating strong and stable interaction with p300. EPS496 effectively inhibited the proliferation of normal melanoma cells with GI(50) values of 367.8 nM, 986.4 nM, and 642.1 nM in A375, SK-MEL-28, and A2058 respectively. The compound retained the anti-proliferative efficacy in the resistant A375(VR), SK-MEL-28(VR), and A2058(VR) with respective GI(50) values of 345.6 nM, 1018 nM, and 708.5 nM. Whereas vemurafenib was less active several folds in the resistant cells. EPS496 promoted early, and phase apoptosis and reduced p300-positive populations in the vemurafenib-resistant melanoma cells. CONCLUSION: EPS496, through its inhibition of p300, provides a novel approach to counteract vemurafenib resistance in melanoma. Results highlight its potential to be developed as an effective therapeutic agent for combating melanoma.
abstract_zh: 背景：黑色素瘤是一种高度侵袭性的皮肤癌，常由BRAF(V600E)突变驱动。维莫非尼（Vemurafenib）初期提供临床获益，但常因继发性突变和补偿性信号通路而产生耐药性。靶向p300（一种参与转录调控和耐药机制的组织蛋白乙酰转移酶）为克服这一治疗挑战提供了潜在策略。方法：进行了虚拟筛选以识别靶向p300的小分子。采用分子动力学模拟 (molecular dynamics simulations, MDS)、均方根偏差 (Root Mean Square Deviation, RMSD) 和分子力学泊松-玻尔兹曼表面积 (Molecular Mechanics Poisson-Boltzmann Surface Area, MMPBSA) 进行计算预测。使用正常（A2058、A375和SK-MEL-28）和维莫非尼耐药A2058(VR)、A375(VR)和SK-MEL-28(VR)黑色素瘤细胞进行细胞实验。结果：EPS496被鉴定为p300抑制剂，在MDS中表现出高结合稳定性和低RMSD值。MMPBSA分析显示其结合能非常有利，表明与p300存在强且稳定的相互作用。EPS496有效抑制正常黑色素瘤细胞的增殖，在A375、SK-MEL-28和A2058中的GI(50)值分别为367.8 nM、986.4 nM和642.1 nM。该化合物在耐药A375(VR)、SK-MEL-28(VR)和A2058(VR)中保留了抗增殖效力，相应的GI(50)值分别为345.6 nM、1018 nM和708.5 nM。而维莫非尼在耐药细胞中的活性低数倍。EPS496促进了维莫非尼耐药黑色素瘤细胞的早期和晚期凋亡，并减少了p300阳性细胞群。结论：EPS496通过抑制p300，提供了一种对抗黑色素瘤中维莫非尼耐药的新方法。结果突显了其作为有效治疗药物对抗黑色素瘤的开发潜力。
